adhocladen live operator/station data + GoingElectric EVSE identifier cross-check

policy: GLS is a shared EVSE prefix across heterogeneous physical operators, so no prefix-wide tariff is inferred. This seed records only two exact DE*GLS EVSE at the Stockelsdorf GLS Mobility site, where live station-level ad-hoc data currently reports 0.54 EUR/kWh and the EVSE identifiers are independently cross-checked. Other DE*GLS EVSE remain unpriced until individually mapped to their physical operator and direct-price source.
